title: Chicken Breast Stuffed with Spinach Blue Cheese and Bacon
description: Spinach-stuffed chicken breasts with blue cheese and crispy bacon make a flavorful, company-worthy main dish that’s ready in just 45 minutes.
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded to 1/2 inch thickness
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Stir spinach and blue cheese together in a medium bowl. Stir in crumbled bacon until evenly combined.

Place chicken breast halves on a clean work surface. Divide spinach mixture evenly among the centers. Fold chicken over filling and secure with toothpicks. Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a shallow dish. Coat chicken in flour mixture.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown chicken on both sides. Transfer to a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the chicken reads 165 degrees F (74 degrees C), about 30 minutes. Remove toothpicks before serving.
